messages:
leo (Platform): Quick q — planning a 10-week remote stint in HI (Aug 1 -> Oct 9). Do I need to file anything? curious about WFH stipend, payroll withholding, and shipping my docked laptop to a short-term rental. :palm_tree:
zoe (People Ops): Hi Leo 4 please submit the temporary homebase form for stays >30 days so we can log payroll/tax exposure and equipment requests. Link: https://hr.redwood.example/homebase-declare
leo (Platform): If I submit, will stipend be paid full month or prorated across months?
mike (Finance): Stipend is prorated by calendar days in each pay period. Example: $200/mo -> Aug 1-31 full month if you're there entire month; if dates span months we split by actual days per month. We'll post exact calc after form is processed.
leo (Platform): Any payroll withholding surprises with HI? I normally live in WA (no state income tax) but Hawaii has income tax.
mike (Finance): Good catch. Short-term work in HI can trigger nonresident withholding. Our tax partner will review once you file. Expect a payroll review within 4 business days and we'll flag if HI withholding applies.
leo (Platform): Cool. About the laptop  I want to ship my work laptop to the rental address. Is that covered?
equip-bot: Domestic temporary shipping policy: covered up to $100 for moves <=90 days. Open an equipment ticket and attach the homebase-declare confirmation. For shipping values above $100 request manager pre-approval.
leo (Platform): Ticket EQ-3307 created, asked for insured next-day to the rental address.
cass (Manager): Cass here  approved the temporary move and shipping. Please include coverage notes on the ticket.
zoe (People Ops): Thanks Cass. Leo, a few items: worker comp stays with your permanent homebase for <182 days; benefits not affected for a 10-week move; please keep emergency contact updated in ADP. Also, if you plan to do any client-facing on-site work while in HI, mention that on the form.
leo (Platform): Good to know. One more: will this impact my health benefits network?
zoe (People Ops): No change for a temporary stay under 182 days. If you enroll in local providers we may need to update records.
mike (Finance): After payroll review we will post whether HI nonresident withholding is required and any net-pay impact. You should see an update here within 4 business days.
leo (Platform): Submitted the form. hr-bot: "homebase-declare" submitted by leo at 2812349999. Next steps: POps review -> Payroll/TAX review (4 business days) -> Equip ticket EQ-3307 processing.
zoe (People Ops): All set  will follow up in-thread once payroll posts. Enjoy the trip! :sun_with_face:
